name: Cube Core Open-Source Semantic Layer
free_limit: Free self-hosted Cube Core semantic layer for reusable metrics, dimensions and joins with SQL, REST and GraphQL APIs and built-in caching; no open-source software license quota.
watch_out: Cube Core is a headless semantic layer, not the paid managed Cube analytics platform or a bundled dashboard UI. You operate Docker/servers, data sources and cache infrastructure; warehouse queries and cloud resources may cost money. Development mode disables authentication on API and Playground endpoints: never expose it publicly or use it in production. Backend Apache-2.0; client packages may be MIT.
